name: ultimate-agent-stack
description: A guarded, npm-distributed operating system for taking software work from plain-language intent through verified review closure.

interface.shortDescription: Autonomous delivery with proof and review gates.
interface.longDescription: Safely installs and updates a repository, shapes ambiguous work conversationally, implements vertical slices, verifies behavior, and closes GitHub and CodeRabbit review loops while preserving human authority over irreversible decisions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $run-autonomous-delivery to take my request from intent through verified review closure. If this repository is not configured yet, run $setup-autonomous-project first.
